features.name: Summarize with Copilot
features.description: A feature that highlights what is most important and urgent for users on Business Central pages with one click, producing tailored and concise text to help users make decisions faster using AI. Shows 2-3 bullet points of highest scoring insights in a summary fact box, with option to click show more for chat experience with additional details.
caveats: Available on single entity pages like card documents or list pages
Works with custom partner-created pages
Shows top 2-3 most important insights in summary fact box
Show more feature has lower click-through rates

features.name: Multi-Prompt Pipeline for Summarization
features.description: The summarization feature uses a pipeline of multiple prompts: a find insights prompt that analyzes data from the current page, related pages, and fact boxes in parallel, followed by a summarize prompt that selects top insights and applies markdown formatting. Uses function calling to make output deterministic by requiring each insight reference source data IDs.
caveats: Requires careful data source selection to balance performance
Uses scoring for insights based on guiding questions and data context

features.name: Statistics Page Integration for Summarization
features.description: The feature filters related pages to include only those containing aggregated data from statistics pages, as the team discovered through experiments that aggregated data is more performant and effective for summarization than raw ledger entries.
caveats: Statistics pages must be named as such to be recognized
Relies on existing Business Central metadata structures

features.name: User Role-Based Filtering for Insights
features.description: Copilot uses user role information to filter and prioritize which insights are most relevant, such as showing business KPIs to managers or inventory details to warehouse managers.
caveats: Currently uses role as primary user context signal

features.name: User Intent Detection for Future Summarization
features.description: A planned enhancement to track user intent through navigation patterns and frequently used pages to better understand context for what summary insights should be shown. The system is still being stabilized with future plans to expand user context tracking.
caveats: Still being stabilized
Navigation patterns and intent detection still under design
Future plans to expand beyond current version

features.name: External Data Integration for Summarization
features.description: A planned future enhancement to integrate external data sources like LinkedIn or OneDrive alongside Business Central database data for enriched summarization context.
features.status_evidence_quote: Right now all the sources that I mentioned are coming from the business central database itself but we could easily think of uh you
caveats: Currently in planning stage only
Would require integration with external systems
Conceptual discussion of possibilities

features.name: Harm testing for AI responses
features.description: Testing methodology that uses an LLM to verify AI responses do not contain harmful content against a defined set of harms available in Azure AI Foundry.
caveats: Requires defined list of harms
Uses LLM to perform the testing

features.name: Accuracy and grounding testing
features.description: Testing approach to ensure AI is not hallucinating and is grounded in the provided input data. Applied at code level, data input level, and prompt level. Uses function calling to make output structure deterministic by requiring each insight reference source data IDs.
caveats: Grounding can be applied at multiple levels
Requires careful data filtering and prompt engineering

features.name: Functional testing for summarization
features.description: Testing approach that involves LLM to verify summaries contain expected insights based on role and scenario. Creates large test datasets with multiple roles and scenarios, then uses prompted evaluation to verify relevant insights appear.
caveats: Requires comprehensive test datasets
Involves multiple quality metrics beyond single pass-fail criteria

features.name: Summary quality metrics
features.description: Multiple metrics defined to measure summary quality including presence of expected insights, certainty, brevity, and precision. Precision measures consistency of form and style across regenerations.
caveats: No single right answer for quality
Requires iterative refinement with customer feedback

features.name: Experimentation framework for AI features
features.description: Capability to run experiments testing different prompts on a small population of users to measure outcomes and verify if changes produce better results before wider rollout. Summarization identified as candidate for experiments.
caveats: Full details not yet disclosed
Subject of future episode

features.name: GPT-4o model usage for ground checks
features.description: Previous model used for summarization ground checks and related tasks before migration to newer models.
caveats: Being phased out in favor of GPT-4o mini

features.name: GPT-4o mini model adoption
features.description: Small language model that is performant and faster than larger models. Used for summarization feature to provide results in a couple of seconds. All ground checks and related prompts have been migrated from GPT-4o to GPT-4o mini.
caveats: Still relatively large models requiring significant hardware
Some prompts may benefit from larger models with better reasoning capabilities

features.name: Model reasoning and selection strategy
features.description: Approach to selecting models based on feature needs. Acknowledges that scoring and reasoning parts of summarization might benefit from different models like GPT-4o1 with better reasoning capabilities, while maintaining flexibility to experiment.
caveats: No definitive right answer yet
Still experimenting with newer models
Trade-offs between different model capabilities

features.name: Small language model advantages and trade-offs
features.description: Small language models offer cost advantages and performance benefits over larger models. However, they require maintenance and present trade-offs between using existing models versus maintaining custom models.
caveats: Require ongoing maintenance
Trade-offs between cost and resource investment

features.name: Summarization with multiple model support
features.description: The summarization feature can use different AI models depending on the feature need. Different prompts may benefit from different models - for example, the scoring part could use models with better reasoning capabilities than 4.1 mini.
caveats: Response time increases with more capable models
Different models have different cost implications

features.name: Summarization with custom entities
features.description: Summarization works out of the box with custom entities. Developers can influence summarization performance through metadata, fact boxes, and descriptive captions and tooltips.
caveats: Not directly extensible from AL yet - developers cannot provide more data sources or override summary text directly
Limited control over summary behavior at this time

features.name: Summary metadata and AI context improvements
features.description: Developers can improve summarization by defining custom entities with better metadata, adding fact boxes for more data sources, and providing clear tooltips, captions and descriptive text that help LLMs understand the entity context.
caveats: Developers must actively maintain this descriptive metadata
